headline: Orient Bell Limited: Granting/withdrawal/surrender/cancellation/suspension of key licenses/ regulatory approvals

why_it_matters: Securing regulatory clearance resolves a decisive approval milestone for ORIENTBELL Limited, unlocking immediate commercialization potential and expanding addressable revenue opportunity in key target markets.
fundamental_impact: Positive — enables immediate commercialization and expands addressable target market reach.
